d:
A 34-year-old woman from Maharashtra’s Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar was found dead in a residential complex in Pune.
She had reportedly gone to London in July 2025 to pursue an MBA but returned to India secretly in August 2026.
Her family believed she was still in London until bank transactions revealed food delivery and online service payments in India.
Police found her body inside a rented apartment in Gahunje, Pune, with no visible external injury marks.
The exact cause of death is still under investigation, and further medical tests are expected to provide more answers.
